subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Investigates and reflects on natural phenomena: what causes day and night (globe and torch)

show.line: The Earth turns round and round. Our side faces the sun: day! Away: night!

rounds.prompt: Our side of the Earth faces the sun. Is it day or night?
Our side turns away from the sun. Is it day or night?
What does the Earth do to give us day and night?
Which one is like the sun in our game?
rounds.praise: The torch is like the sun!

rounds.prompt: What time do you wake up? Day or night?

hints: The sun stays still. The Earth turns.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I know why we have night.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: At night the sun goes to sleep!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The Earth turns away from the sun.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: The Earth turns. Our side faces away. Night!

parent_line: Knows day and night happen because the Earth turns.
